name: Duskline
summary: A smart-home app in smoked glass with one blue accent, over black-and-white drawn rooms
about: A complete control app for one family house, with smoked glass panels floating over black-and-white pictures of each room that crossfade as you move around. Lights dim, the air conditioning follows a draggable dial, doors lock behind a PIN pad, and four drawn cameras run live with a ticking clock. Good for a smart-home or home-automation product; dark by default with a pale grey light theme.
how: Pick a room in the strip on Home: the black-and-white room behind the glass crossfades and its devices appear as chips
Tap a chip or a switch: the room picture brightens as lights come on, and the live kW reading moves
In Rooms, drag the dimmer and volume sliders, nudge the air conditioning up or down, or pair a new device
Open a camera for night vision, a snapshot flash, talk and pause, with today's motion list
In Security, choose Home or Away and type the PIN on the keypad; lock or unlock doors and search the activity log
Drag the thermostat dial in Climate, switch 24H, 7D, 30D, 12M in Energy, and run scenes that change devices one by one
Create, edit, run and delete automations, make guest access codes, and reset the demo in Settings
